fields.Name: Integration Tests
fields.Description: Parent suite for the metadata-driven Integration Test TestType (graduated from packages/MJServer/integration-test-scripts). Tiering is expressed as sibling child suites: 'Integration Tests — Deterministic' is the credential-free, blocking tier; 'Integration Tests — Live Model' is the opt-in, token-costing tier. The mutation axis is NOT a separate suite — mutation checks live inside the deterministic suite's tests and are gated at runtime by the driver reading RUN_MUTATION_TESTS.

fields.Name: Integration Tests — Deterministic
fields.Description: The blocking, credential-free integration tier. Members run with no LLM credentials against a live DB/transport. Mutation-class checks (S17/S23/S24, C10) are ordinary members gated at runtime by RUN_MUTATION_TESTS — they appear here but only fire when the driver sees the env gate. IT03 (client/GraphQL) is seeded Skip until MJAPI is provisioned in CI (Phase 5). ORDERING INVARIANT: client-transport members are sequenced LAST — bootstrapIntegrationClient rebinds the process's global provider to GraphQL, so no server-transport member may run after the first client one.
